# Distribution

What another website links to. Everything here is generated by `python3 scripts/build_dist.py`; edit `brand/`, not this folder.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `tiansight.css` | The whole foundation in one file: font faces, tokens, element defaults, every `.ts-` component. **Latest channel** — a site linking this picks up each push. |
| `tiansight-v0.6.css` | The same content frozen at the version in `brand/VERSION`. **Pinned channel** — a site linking this never changes until it opts in. |
| `tokens.json` | The tokens as data (Design Tokens Community Group format) for Figma, build scripts or another framework. |
| `icons.svg` | The icon sprite, for `<use href="icons.svg#ts-arrow-right"/>` on same-origin or CORS-enabled hosting. |
| `product/manifest.json` | Verified namespaced application bundle: CSS, runtime, tokens, fonts/licenses, sprite and logo, with per-file integrity hashes. See `docs/product-distribution.md`. |
| `tiansight-<sha256>.css` | Immutable content-addressed snapshot of the latest legacy bundle. Existing version-named pins remain unchanged. |
| `example.html` | A working page that links only `tiansight.css`. Copy it as a starting point. |

## Publishing

GitHub Actions automatically rebuilds and validates the preview after each push to `main`, then deploys the `_site/` artifact to GitHub Pages. Pages settings use **GitHub Actions**, with custom domain `tiansight.apuch.art`.

```
https://tiansight.apuch.art/dist/tiansight.css
https://tiansight.apuch.art/dist/tiansight-v0.7.css
https://tiansight.apuch.art/dist/tokens.json
https://tiansight.apuch.art/brand/index.html
```

Run `python3 scripts/build_preview.py` to reproduce the deployment artifact locally. The public `/build.json` records the deployed commit. See the root README for DNS and rollback instructions.

A public repository is also served by jsDelivr with no settings at all, which is useful for pinning to a tag:

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ksamint/dsys_tiansight02@main/dist/tiansight.css
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ksamint/dsys_tiansight02@v0.6/dist/tiansight.css
```

## Which channel to give a partner

- A marketing page, a campaign microsite, an internal tool: **latest**. It stays in step with the brand for free.
- A production application, or anything a client sees on a deadline: **pinned**. Move it forward deliberately after reading `CHANGELOG.md`.

Whichever they use, a change to a token or a component reaches every consumer of that channel. Treat `brand/tokens.css` and `brand/components.css` as a published interface: rename nothing without a note in `CHANGELOG.md`, and keep an old pinned file in place once a site links it.

## Fonts

Webfonts are bundled in `brand/fonts/` with provenance and OFL licenses. The latest legacy bundle resolves them at `../brand/fonts/`; the product bundle includes its own font directory. Unicode subsets load on demand, with local serif fallbacks. Old versioned CSS pins retain their historical fallback declarations.
